### Added

- (agent-platform) [Usage → Cost by organization, with an Organization scope](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3312) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — Usage's Cost view has a `By organization` table with each organization's spend, tokens, model calls and share of spend. An `Organization` select on Overview and Cost, shown from two organizations on, narrows every figure to one; `Show all organizations` goes back.
- (agent-platform) [Usage reports a calendar month, with spend by person on Cost](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3322) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — On Usage's Overview and Cost, the `Time range` select offers calendar months after the day ranges, such as `October 2026` and `November 2026 so far`. In a month, Cost adds a `By person` table; calls that name nobody read `No person recorded`.

### Development and CI/CD

- (release) [Version packages](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3293) by [@giantswarm-release[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-release[bot]) — Turns the queued changesets into new versions and changelog entries of the plugin packages, such as agent-platform 1.1.0. Nothing changes in the portal itself.
- (release) [Version packages](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3325) by [@giantswarm-release[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-release[bot]) — Turns the queued changesets into new versions and changelog entries of the plugin packages, such as agent-platform 1.2.0. Nothing changes in the portal itself.
